services.name: 4th of July Fireworks Viewing
services.desc: About Join us for an unforgettable 4th of July fireworks experience aboard our boat in Newport, Rhode Island! We’ll anchor at our mooring, providing the perfect vantage point to view the fireworks while listening to some great music. Once it’s dark, sit back, relax, and enjoy the show! Feel free to bring your favorite snacks and drinks (Please, no hard alcohol. We aim to ensure a fun and safe time for all). We will provide a cooler to keep your beverages ice cold! Please call 401-601-0330 to inquire about a private fireworks
